messages:
Maria L.: quick heads-up — opened PR to slim provider blocks across a few tf modules and pin to our mirror. also moved some k8s secret paths. need a quick smoke/plan check before I merge. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/472

```hcl
# modules/network/providers.tf (old -> new)
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source = "registry.mirror.redwood/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = var.region
}
```

I also regenerated `terraform.lock.hcl` but left it in the branch for review. The k8s secret mount path changed from `infra/credentials` -> `k8s/infra/credentials` so CI will fail if the staging secret isn't seeded.

Aj K.: on it. quick Q: did you change the service account / secret name in the k8s manifests too? last time that broke staging deploys and nobody noticed until pipeline ran.

Maria L.: yep — manifest updated. example: `envFrom: secretRef: name: infra-creds` -> `name: k8s-infra-creds`. I also updated `tools/ci/seed-secrets.sh` to write the new path.

Devon P.: ran a local `terraform init -backend-config=staging` + `terraform plan` against the branch. plan looks clean except provider address mismatch for postgres provider — our lockfile still references `registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/postgres` but the pinned mirror is `registry.mirror.redwood/hashicorp/postgres`. snippet from plan: 

```diff
- provider["registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/postgres"]
+ provider["registry.mirror.redwood/hashicorp/postgres"]
```

Tanvi R.: if you have a lockfile mismatch, add `required_providers` with the mirror source in the module root and then run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` (or our CI `make tf-lock`). also please add a short note in the module README about using the mirror to avoid surprises for consumers.

Maria L.: added the `required_providers` pins in the root module in the PR and re-ran `make tf-lock`. pushed the updated `terraform.lock.hcl`. PTAL @Aj K. @Devon P.

Aj K.: LGTM from my side after the lock regen. left one tiny nit about alias usage in `k8s/ingress` module — prefer explicit `provider = aws.regional` vs relying on implicit.

infra-bot: deploy pipeline: branch `pr/472` — tf validate ✅, tf plan (staging) — no resource diffs, seeding check: missing secret for staging detected -> job `seed-staging-secrets` queued.

Maria L.: thanks, I'll seed staging and address Aj's nit. plan to merge after seeds are present. :thumbsup:
